# openrz67.github.io

Project site for [openrz67](https://github.com/openrz67), served by GitHub Pages from `main`.

Plain HTML and CSS in `index.html`, plus `privacy.html` and `support.html` (the App Store/Play privacy policy and support URLs; each carries its own small copy of the styles). Images in `img/`. No build step.

`img/case-pcb.png` is a Blender render of the trigger enclosure and board,
**regenerated by `render/render.sh`** — never by hand. It rebuilds the case STLs and
the board GLB from the `openrz67-trigger` working copy next to this one, then renders
`render/render_case.py` headless. Rendered on transparency with a shadow catcher, so
the page background shows through.

    cd render && ./render.sh              # inputs + render
    ./render.sh --no-inputs               # render only
    SAVE_BLEND=1 ./render.sh              # also write render/case-pcb.blend
    ./render.sh nrf [--no-inputs]         # img/nrf-case-pcb.png, the coin-cell board

The nRF render (`render/render_nrf.py`) reuses the look and camera from
`render_case.py`; its lifts and board placement are constants at its top, in sync
with `nrf/case/openrz67_nrf_case.py`.

Camera and look are environment overrides (`CAM_AZ`, `CAM_EL`, `CAM_LENS`,
`CAM_MARGIN`, `RENDER_RES`, `RENDER_SAMPLES`, `RENDER_EXPOSURE`). The exploded lifts
(lid +42 mm, PCB +16 mm) and the board's position in case coordinates are constants at
the top of `render_case.py`; keep them in sync with `esp32/case/openrz67_case.py`.

The first version of this image was made by hand and went stale within a day — it still
showed the SS12F15 slide switch after the KCD11 rocker had landed. That is what the
script is for.
